title:
Epic triggered by `BUTTON_CLICK` of the `Edit button inside the side panel where the user can see the details of the
of an existing {@link ReliabilityMetric}.
In this epic the actions triggered are:
- Set to false the `isNewMetric` flag in the MetricConfigApplicationState. That means that the metric is not new and
is being edited.
- Redirect to the `Create Metric` page.
- Populate the form with the values of the selected metric.
name: StartEditWorkflowEpic
